runtime_verification_scope: Flash hash verified; face stage 2 app, camera capture, and gimbal CLI/PWM state receipts observed after boot. This does not establish face tracking or automatic centering acceptance.
pan_motion_scope: User visually confirmed base servo and camera bracket move horizontally during manual 1500->1525->1500->1475->1500us sequence; final status both PWM channels off.
tilt_motion_scope: User visually confirmed upper servo and camera bracket move together during manual 1500->1525->1500us sequence; final status both PWM channels off.
face_target_during_pan_trial: people=0; no valid face target for image-direction calibration

servo_power_source.user_confirmed: Two servo 5V leads soldered together and connected to main-board 5V/VBUS; no independent servo supply.

motion_test_status: User isolated the downward movement to arm tilt; both trials end at the same low position and stabilize. Routine motion and automatic centering remain paused pending startup-position calibration.

tilt_incident.observed_at: User confirmed movement occurs immediately after arm tilt, which commands fixed 1500us.
tilt_incident.off_power_observation: User reports no obvious gravity sag and slack cable while supporting bracket after unplugging USB.
tilt_incident.power_up_observation: User reports no movement on reconnecting USB before any servo command.
tilt_incident.latest_agent_test: Earlier agent trial: arm tilt 1500us, hold about 5 seconds, stop; final status both PWM channels off. Superseded for event timing by later user-operated trials.
tilt_incident.repeatability_user_confirmed: Both trials reach the same low position and then remain stable.
tilt_incident.working_hypothesis: Fixed 1500us startup position does not match desired camera direction; physical mounting/calibration not yet checked. Servo rail voltage is unmeasured; power fault not excluded.

target_readiness_after_reframing.meaning: Short read-only target window; does not establish 30-second continuous pose input or calibrated servo directions.
